guidetextdraw_1804076810._value:
Please Note:

  • Expired documentation will not be accepted. School ID is an acceptable form of an Identification Card.
  • Attachment does not support following special characters / \\ : * ? & { } ; [ ]
  • Only PDF, JPEG, PNG, JPG, TIF & TIFF files are allowed.

Directions:

Please attach the required documents and upload a copy. Below are examples of acceptable documents for each category:

  • Name Change – Legal Name Change Decree, Marriage Certificate, or Divorce Decree 
    • Must include both your previous and new name; if not, provide two forms of identification. 
  • Name Change Typo – Identification Card, Passport, or Birth Certificate
  • Email Update – Identification Card
  • Date of Birth Correction – Birth Certificate, or Passport
  • Social Security Number (SSN) Correction – Social Security Card and another form of Identification.
  • California Statewide Student Identifier (CA SSID) – Identification Card
